completion_data.completion_summary: Updated /spawn command to work from any non-terminal state with terminal-state-only validation, added holistic analysis mode with interactive AskUserQuestion confirmation to spawn-agent, and enhanced skill-spawn with previous_status preservation and empty-task handling. All changes applied to both .opencode/ and .claude/ trees.

memory_candidates.content: When modifying files that exist in both .opencode/ and .claude/ trees, search for all copies (including in extensions/core/ subdirectories) before starting edits. The system maintains duplicate command files in both root commands/ and extensions/core/commands/ paths, and leaving one set unmodified creates inconsistency. Use glob or grep first to discover all instances.

The spawn command has two semantic modes: blocker-driven (status is blocked/implementing/partial or blocker_prompt provided) and holistic (all other non-terminal states). This dual-mode pattern can be applied to other commands that need different behavior based on task state. The mode is passed via delegation context as analysis_mode field.

When implementing interactive confirmation in agents using AskUserQuestion with multiSelect, always provide a clear empty-selection handling path. The agent should write a valid return file with an empty array rather than omitting the file, so that the calling skill can distinguish between 'user cancelled' and 'agent failed' states.
